correctness.rationale: For any positive weights and T>0, retained Boolean vertices yield pairwise disjoint strict opposite orthants; each absent singleton yields a further incompatible active-cone witness at the cut edge leaving the all-negative vertex. Every new vertex of a single halfspace-cut cube lies on a cube edge; explicit coordinate directions strictly decrease the cap functional and enter all its active cube facets. These give matching ordinary and fractional bounds, including ties. Exact rational verifier independently passed 354 systems/15035 checks; these are finite checks rather than proof.

value.rationale: A full all-dimensional weighted and tied-threshold classification computes both illumination invariants from higher-order Boolean subset sums. It proves equality of ordinary and fractional illumination on nontrivial noncentrally symmetric polytopes and detects additional forced directions at missing singleton corners; e.g. (3,1,1) at T=5/2 gives I=5 while only four cube vertices survive. The exact binomial staircase for equal weights provides meaningful sharp phase transitions.
